subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this umbrella stay open until both cron retention cleanup and cadence guardrail decisions are resolved, or should maintainers split the remaining context-warning work into a narrower canonical issue now?
rationale: The retention gap is source-reproducible, but the full request combines bug fix, cleanup semantics, operator warnings, and possible cadence policy; automation cannot choose the durable product boundary for those pieces.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Through Linked PRs
options.body: Use this issue to track the combined user impact until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89739 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90194 land, are rejected, or are replaced.

options.title: Split Remaining Warning Work
options.body: Keep the retention and cadence slices on their narrower refs, then open or select a separate issue for any context-pressure warning that remains after those PRs settle.

options.title: Close After Narrow Canonicals Are Confirmed
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers explicitly confirm the narrower open items cover every actionable part of the report.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Through Linked PRs
recommendation.body: Use this issue to track the combined user impact until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89739 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90194 land, are rejected, or are replaced.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership plus maintainer-facing product-boundary context makes this the best available decision route from the history inspected.
